messages: Every fire pump must have a containing compartment with maintained temperature above 0 deg C.
violations.query:
PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
            PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
            PREFIX unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this nltl:hasComponent ?pump .
                ?pump a ?pumpType .
                FILTER (
                    ?pumpType IN (
                        nltl:firePump,
                        nltl:emergencyFirePump,
                        nltl:waterMistPump,
                        nltl:waterSprayPump
                    )
                )
                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    ?pump nltl:hasContainingCompartment ?compartment .
                    ?compartment nltl:maintainedTemperature ?quantity .
                    ?quantity qudt:numericValue ?value ;
                              qudt:unit unit:DEG_C .
                    FILTER (
                        datatype(?value) = xsd:decimal &&
                        ?value > 0
                    )
                }
            }

blocker.detail: The negative rejects and the intended-only repair passes, but one or more reported logical/SPARQL/complex-path failures lack a reviewed semantic correspondence. No strict credit is inferred from verdicts alone.

likely_cause.detail: The independently valid intended-only counterfactual still rejects or violation meaning is not established. Reports are saved; no context-vs-generator cause is invented.
